pilot_A.response_window_rule: smallest prespecified candidate window containing at least 95% of terminal decisions among engaged calibration trials, subject to a predeclared upper bound
pilot_A.failure: if no candidate reaches 95%, redesign/re-run pilot rather than tune on confirmatory treatments

allowed: pooled correctness within frozen response window

sample_size_policy.pilot_goal: nuisance estimation and operational feasibility, not focal hypothesis power
sample_size_policy.next_product: operating-characteristic surface over individuals-per-cell, trials-per-individual, nuisance parameters, and a grid of scientifically relevant effects

promotion_gate: stable response window from Pilot A
measurable pooled B=3 performance without catastrophic non-response
nuisance receipt produced without opening H1/H2
schedule feasible under available colony/individual supply
sample-size operating-characteristic analysis frozen before confirmatory allocation
claim_ceiling: The pilot can establish operational measurability and nuisance calibration only; it is not an empirical routeability test.

outputs: frozen response-window selection from prespecified candidate grid
pooled B3 success and timeout fractions
balanced repeated-trial ICC moment when estimable
randomized-individual dropout fraction when randomized IDs are supplied
